//: Every path serves the app, because the app reads the path.
Vercel serves `dist` as static files, so without this anything that is not
exactly `/` is a file that does not exist and comes back 404. That breaks
two things immediately: `/dev7731`, which is the control room and the only
way to reach the car settings, and any link straight to a place.
The query-string entries — ?section=, ?rally=, ?hour= — survive a rewrite
on their own, so this one line covers all of them.
